text: Wrap God is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating Mchimba the Embalmer without him finishing a cast of Open Coffin and with entombed players using Struggle no more than once per cast of Entomb.

Worm-monger is a dungeons & raids achievement earned by defeating Garothi Worldbreaker in Antorus, the Burning Throne after decimating 16 Blightscale Worms on Normal difficulty or higher.

Wraithwisp Sinew drops from heroic mode Sylvanas Windrunner in the Sanctum of Domination for players who have the normal version of Rae'shalare, Death's Whisper.
Wraps of the Twilight Grove are randomly awarded from Night Fae daily quests in Korthia.
Worn Defias Bindings are a quest reward from Evidence Collection.
Wrangler's Chain Cinch is a quest reward from Young and Vicious.

Worneblade is sold by Griftah in the Broker's Den in Oribos.
Wraith Vanguard is a death elemental encountered by adventure companions in Maldraxxus.

The Worn Book is the remains of the Earthbound Tome after the seal has been broken.
Wounded Ossuary Guards are red drakonid and red dragonspawn located at the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus.

The Wounded Initiate is a centaur of Clan Ohn'ir located with Tigari Khan and the Badly Wounded Mystics on the road north of Ridgewater Retreat in the Ohn'ahran Plains during Mystic Mystery, Toting Totems, and Taken By Storm. At the start of Catching Wind, she gets to her hooves and walks off and despawns alongside Tigari and the Mystics.

Wrangler Rendra is a red dragonspawn located in the Wild Feeding Pits in the Waking Shores.
Worn Brass Key drops from Captain Grub Redcut on a ship in the Southern Savage Coast in the Cape of Stranglethorn. It is used to open the Treasure Chest.

Wrap of Raging Tempests is sold by Mythressa for and Rethelshi in Valdrakken for .
Wrap of the Chosen Dead is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Garb of the Chosen Dead.

The Worldsoul Saga is the name given for a trilogy of expansions starting with the tenth and ending with the twelfth. The three expansion are, in order: World of Warcraft: The War Within, World of Warcraft: Midnight, & World of Warcraft: The Last Titan.

Worn Troll Dice is a pair of 6-sided dice. When used they show a descriptive emote, with the item name as a tooltip followed by a /roll 6 twice: : casually tosses [Worn Troll Dice]. : rolls (1-6) : rolls (1-6)
"Wrath of Soulflayer" is a book about the history of Hakkar. Found at: * Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale - building near fishing vendor * Gadgetzan in Tanaris - inn
The Wrath of Cenarius is a ring that will occasionally give bonus damage to your offensive spells.
Wren Darkspring is a gnome warlock located in Anvilmar in Dun Morogh.
Wrath of Air Totem is a totem that grants 5% spell haste to all party and raid members within 40 yards.
Wrenix the Wretched is a level 20 goblin located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens. Along side him is Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus.
Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus is a mechanical pet belonging to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet of Northern Barrens.

Wrathscale Lair are ancient remains night elf ruins cresting the apex of a hill on Bloodmyst Isle. Adventurers need to come here for a quest to slay Lord Xiz. The area has also been tainted by the Exodar's blood crystals, like most of Bloodmyst Isle.
Wrathscale Naga can be found in Azuremyst Isle on a hill and all along the western coast.
Wrath of Spellfire is a cloth epic crafted set created by Tailoring.
Wrathtide Longbow drops from Warlord Kalithresh in the Steamvault wing of Coilfang Reservoir in Heroic difficulty with drop rate approximately 10%.
Wrathfire Hand-Cannon drops from Grandmaster Vorpil in the Shadow Labyrinth wing of Auchindoun.
Wrathbringer Laz-tarash is a wrathguard contained within one of the Ethereum Prison cells at the Ethereum Staging Grounds in Netherstorm.

Wrath Masters are rathguard found in Hellfire Peninsula. They are under the command of the Pit Commander to invade Azeroth and constantly attack the Stair of Destiny. They are part of the "Marauding Agents of Evil".
Wrathscale Sorceresses are naga found at the Ruins of Loreth'Aran in Bloodmyst Isle.
Wrathscale Marauders are naga found at the Ruins of Loreth'Aran in Bloodmyst Isle.
Wrathtail Heads drop from the following naga in Ashenvale: * Wrathtail Myrmidon * Wrathtail Wave Rider * Wrathtail Razortail * Wrathtail Priestess * Wrathtail Sorceress * Wrathtail Sea Witch

Wrekt Slaves are Broken found in Zangarmarsh that are called by surrounding naga to aid them in battle. They give 2.5 reputation point per kill towards Cenarion Expedition until Friendly only if they are not currently under the control of a Bloodscale Overseer.
Wrath of the Betrayer is chapter 4 of the Terror of the Tides campaign.
Wrath Hammer Constructs are golems found in Blackrock Depths.
Wrathbone Flayers are skeletons found in Black Temple. Killing them will reward 15 reputation with Ashtongue Deathsworn.

The Wrekt are a group of Broken, part of whom were enslaved by Illidan's Naga in Zangarmarsh. The Wrekt aren't using the resources in their midst. Those that remained free have allied themselves with the Firewing blood elves and Lost Ones of Tuurem.

Wrath of the Titans is one of the books that can be found inside Sealed Tomes in the Guardian's Library in Karazhan. Using the book consumes it, giving your spells a 3% chance to deal additional elemental damage for one hour.
Wrathtail Sorceresses are naga found at the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. Tyrande Whisperwind killed several of them on her way to reclaim Darkshore during the Fourth War.
Wrathtail Wave Riders are naga found at the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. Tyrande Whisperwind killed several of them on her way to reclaim Darkshore during the Fourth War.
The Wrathscale are a group of naga found on the Azuremyst Isles. They are led by Warlord Sriss'tiz, who plans to take the isles by force with the help of reinforcements from Nazjatar.
The Wrathfin naga are a group serving Illidan, based in the Underbog. Their presence threatens the draenei, trolls, and Cenarion Expedition that have carved out holdings in the area.
Wrath Enforcers are wrathguard located in the Dead Scar of the Isle of Quel'Danas. They are hostile to both players and the undead in the area.
Wrath Heralds are wrathguard found at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Wrecked Row Boat is located just under water next to the shore of Feralas. This row boat once belonged to Raschal.

Wrench Blackboot is a great dwarven tinker. Before he went deaf, he was hailed for his study of sound and creation of devices to capture and imitate sounds. In his studies, he learned of how sound moves in waves. He was fascinated to learn that a sound could be cancelled by a wave form directly its opposite. Having no love for the arcane arts, he made a waveform canceller specifically to aim at spellcasters, the Wizard Silencer.
Wrekt Warriors are Broken located at Tuurem in Terokkar Forest.
Wrathguard Defender is a wrathguard that was set to appear in the Dark Portal Opens event.
This article is an overview of reputation rewards from Wrath of the Lich King faction vendors.
Wrecking Crew is a Tier 6 talent in the Warrior's Arms tree.
The Wrecked Crab Trap is found underwater near the Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.
Wrath of the Alliance is a pvp achievement earned for when the player has killed 5 horde players in the 4 horde capital kingdoms.
Wrath of the Horde is a pvp achievement earned for when the horde player has killed 5 alliance players in the 4 faction kingdoms.
Wrecking Ball is a pvp achievement earned for when the player has earned 20 killing blows without dying during a single battleground match.

Wrathtail Razortails are naga found at Zoram Strand in Ashenvale.
Wrathtail Priestesses are naga found on Ruuzel's Isle in Ashenvale.
Wrathtail Myrmidons are naga found on Ruuzel's Isle in Ashenvale.
Wrathstrike Gargoyles are gargoyles located at Scourgeholme in Icecrown.
Wrathbone Laborers can be found in the Pit of Saron. They can be pulled solo and will keep healers/ranged occupied with Blinding Dirt while pounding the tank.
Wrathbone Coldwraiths are skeletal mages found in the Pit of Saron.
Wrathbone Skeletons are skeletons found in the Pit of Saron.

Wrathbone Siegesmiths are skeletons found in the Pit of Saron as part of the Forgemaster Garfrost encounter. By aggroing any siegesmith or the forgemaster himself, all siegesmiths will join the fight.
Wrathful Gladiator is a title and achievement awarded for being the highest rated arena team in the battlegroup at the end of Arena Season 8.
Wrathful Gladiator's Battlegear is the Season 8 Warrior arena set.
The Wrathful Gladiator's Pendant of Deliverance drops from Toravon the Ice Watcher in the Vault of Archavon.
Wrath of the Lightbringer is a talent in the Protection tree. It increases the damage of Crusader Strike and Judgment and also increases the critical strike of Holy Wrath and Hammer of Wrath.

The World of Warcraft: Fall of the Lich King Soundtrack was composed by Russell Brower, Derek Duke and Edo Guidotti. It was available exclusively at BlizzCon 2010. This album consists of music added in patch 3.3.0.
Wrenchmen Recruitment Posters can be found in Bilgewater Harbor, Azshara. It starts a quest chain.

Wrathgate was the 11th TCG expansion, released on May 23, 2010. It is set 2 of the Scourgewar Block.

Wrenchcalibur is the weapon wielded by High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. It is roughly shaped like its namesake tool. The complex series of cogs, pistons, runes, and levers somehow enables it to serve as a good mace. Gelbin usually carries Wrenchcalibur in his belt loop, but his skills as a tactician allow him to put up a decent fight without it.
The Wrath of Unchaining drops from Spine of Deathwing in Dragon Soul.

The Wreck of the Vanguard can be found on the southwestern coast of the Jade Forest. It is nestled between Garrosh'ar Point and the Dreamer's Pavilion. It was Admiral Taylor's flagship, and was transporting Anduin Wrynn and his bodyguard. Hozen are now looting it.

The Wreck of the Mist-Hopper can be found on the seafloor of the Shelf of Mazu off the southern shore of the Dread Wastes. This Anglers vessel was supposed to set out on a routine fishing trip off the coast of the Jade Forest, but Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao ended up taking it on a wild journey past the Serpent's Spine that ended with the boat sinking. Soggy and his surviving crew settled at Soggy's Gamble.

The Wreck of Hellscream's Fist is the crash site where the Hellscream's Fist went down after the Alliance struck a fatal blow to her. The area is crawling with hozen. Lorbu Sadsummon, an elite gnome warlock, can occasionally found looking over the site from a few cliff above.

Wrathion's Jewel Chest is placed by Tong in the Tavern in the Mists on the Veiled Stair. It contains an Eye of the Black Prince, awarded by Wrathion to adventurers who complete his second set of challenges.
Wrathscale Shorestalkers are naga found at Wrathscale Lair in Bloodmyst Isle.
Wrathscale Screamers are naga found at Wrathscale Lair in Bloodmyst Isle.
Wrath Warriors are wrathguard located at Despair Ridge on Mardum.
The Wreck of the Mother Lode is a crashed zeppelin coming from Pinchwhistle Gearworks. Its crewmen are scattered about and wounded.

Wrathguard Dreadblades are wrathguard that appear during the battle for the Broken Shore and during the assault on Broken Shore.
Wrath and Fury is a Fury warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Deathdealer, Focus in Chaos (artifact trait), and Odyn's Champion traits.
__NOTOC__ Wrathguard Soulbreakers are wrathguard found in the Assault on Broken Shore scenario. They also appear regularly on the Broken Shore.

Wrathguard Choker can be created from Relinquished Necklace.

Wrathful Sister's Cincture drops from Nez'ara in Vol'dun.

.]] The World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King Soundtrack was composed and arranged by Russell Brower, Derek Duke, Jason Hayes, Neal Acree and Glenn Stafford. It was released with the Collector's Edition of the expansion. At the same time, the soundtrack was released via iTunes, but with three of the tracks changed to other selections. A wyvern, also known as a wind rider and war rider, is a sentient lionish creature with bat wings and a scorpion tail native to Kalimdor. They can speak and understand Orcish and Taur-ahe, but cannot understand Common. Both males and females have manes.
Wyrmkin are a type of dragonspawn. All mobs specifically identified as wyrmkin in WoW are female dragonspawn, with the exception of the Coldarra Wyrmkin.
__NOTOC__ Wynd Nightchaser is a night elf quest giver located in Starfall Village in Winterspring.

Wushoolay is a boss of the Cataclysm version of Zul'Gurub. He can still be found at the Edge of Madness, but he now has to be summoned by a skilled archaeologist. He is one of four available bosses there.
__NOTOC__ Groups of three Death Talon Wyrmguards that are encountered before Ebonroc, Flamegor, and Chromaggus in Blackwing Lair.
Wyrmtongue Shoulders are a pair of Level 42 quality Leather Shoulderpads that improve Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.

Wulmort Jinglepocket is a vendor located in the Commons in Ironforge during the Feast of Winter Veil event. He is affiliated with Smokywood Pastures and sells lower value holiday-related items, although he is also the source of the two high-value clothes recipes. His high value counterpart is Macey Jinglepocket. He is the Goblin Resources Director of the Smokywood Pastures, Inc. He once retold A Very Smokywood Winter Veil story as part of Smokywood Storytime. When he was finished, he expressed annoyed, saying that he hates this time of year.
Wristguards of Vengeance are wrist plate armor primary for dps warriors.

The Writhing Deep is the site of the Hive Zukk'ash silithid infestation in southeastern Feralas. The Zukk'ash silithid are driving the nearby gnolls into a frenzy, which is causing them to try and head north, attacking Camp Mojache. According to locals of Feralas and Zekhan's report after the Fourth War, silithid still swarm in the Writhing Deep, and there is a tug-of-war between gnolls, yetis, silithid, and Horde going on in Feralas. Help from Camp Mojache squashed the insects around the hive, but the silithid and their countless eggs remain protected within. According to Rexxar, it is only a matter of time before the next generation of silithid hatches.
Wushoolay's Charm of Nature is created with the Punctured Voodoo Doll (druid).
Wunna Darkmane is a tauren trade goods vendor located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. She is the only known vendor of Recipe: Roasted Kodo Meat.

Wretched Zombies were very weak undead monsters in the Forsaken starting area, north of Deathknell prior to patch 3.3.0. They were replaced by Wretched Ghouls to avoid confusion with the similar-in-appearance Mindless Zombies.
Writhing Highborne are wraiths of Ameth'Aran that weren't saved by Athrikus Narassin after the Sundering. They've been moved to Bashal'Aran after the Cataclysm.
Wyrmthalak's Shackles are a reward from the following quests: *Maxwell's Mission *Warlord's Command
Wushoolay's Charm of Spirits was created with the Punctured Voodoo Doll (shaman).
Wulan is a jungle troll cooking vendor located in Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
The Wristguards of Renown are a pair of Level 51 quality Leather Wristguards that improve Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Wrinkle Goodsteel is a goblin armor vendor located in Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Wretched Captive can be found in Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. Sergeant Kan'ren interrogates him for the location of Thaelis the Hungerer.

Wrecthed Hooligans are wretched found on and around Sunsail Anchorage in Eversong Woods. Led by Aldaron the Reckless these wretched, along with Wretched Thugs, have succeeded in overthrowing the anchorage.

Wretched Thugs are wretched found on and around Sunsail Anchorage in Eversong Woods. Led by Aldaron the Reckless these wretched, along with Wretched Hooligans, have succeeded in overthrowing the anchorage.
Wrynn Dynasty Greaves are epic plate legs armor for tanks that drop from The Curator in Karazhan. The greaves likely refers to the Llane Wrynn dynasty.

The Writhing Mound is a bone-riddled hill east of Auchindoun in the Bone Wastes of Terokkar Forest. It is populated by Auchenai necromancers. For those trying to get the achievement Explore Terokkar Forest, this can be found at the coordinates:
Wristguards of Undead Slaying dropped from Bone Witches and Spirits of the Damend during the Scourge Invasion.
Wristwraps of Undead Slaying dropped from the following undead during the first Scourge Invasion: *Spirit of the Damned *Bone Witch *Lumbering Horror
Wristgaurds of Determination are epic plate wrist armor for tanks that drop from Void Reaver in the Eye.
Wristbands of Divine Influence are epic cloth wrist armor for healing priests.
The Writhing Haunt Cauldron Key dropped from Cauldron Lord Razarch in Western Plaguelands.
Writhing Mages are human ghosts found on Purgation Isle in Hillsbrad Foothills.

This quest is the reward for escorting the Caravan Mule train safely from Light's Hope Chapel across the main road. You can only get the quest and get the writ signed after protecting the mule train. The train starts out twice per day between 6 and 8 o'clock server time.

Wyrmskull Village is a vrykul village in the Howling Fjord. It is north of, and bordering, Valgarde. It lies right in front of Utgarde Keep and the neighboring Utgarde Catacombs. From here, the Dragonflayer Vrykul attack ships with their harpoon guns. The sway of the Lich King appeared to be strong in this village, which appears to be ancient based on the spirits that dwell here. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that due to its proximity the walls of Valgarde still saw regular attacks from the vrykul of Wyrmskull.
Wyrmhide Spaulders are a quest reward from A Taste of Flame (3) which begins with Cyrus Therepentous in Slither Rock in the Burning Steppes.
__NOTOC__ The Wyrmcult Zealot is a wyrmcult member, who, when low on health, transforms in a dragonkin called Wyrmcult Blessed. They become friendly when wearing the Overseer Disguise.
Wyrmtails are located throughout the southern Dustwallow Marsh.

in Valdrakken.]] Wyrms are the senior citizen of dragons. The wyrm denotation usually signifies a mature dragon more than 500 years old, or simply refers to the adult stage of the dragon life cycle. Aspects, for example, can be considered wyrms.
Wretched Fiends are level 69 wretched located on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Wretched Devourers are level 69 wretched located on the Isle of Quel'Danas. They are involved in the following quests: * The Sanctum Wards * Arm the Wards!
Wretched Bruisers are wretched located in the Magisters' Terrace.
Wretched Skulkers are wretched located in the Magisters' Terrace.
Wretched Husks are wretched located in the Magisters' Terrace.

The Wristguards of Castigation are the Paladin bracers meant to go with the Avenger set from AQ, and were to drop off Ouro or C'Thun. They only showed up on the test server as gear for paladin premade characters. They had the same color scheme as Avenger Set.

Wryxian is either a baby crocolisk or he's an extremely small crocolisk. Either way, little is known about him except that he posted a lot in the EU Beta forum, and that he's green... and seemingly has an over-abundance of limbs. [Speaking about Dame Evniki Kapsalis] Note that you must be a Crusader before she will sell to you. I went to her on my Mage to buy the experience boosting chest piece for my Warlock. Unfortunately my Mage has enough Champion's Seals to buy it, but is not a Crusader... ...so I went to her on my Priest. Unfortunately my Priest is a Crusader, but does not have enough Champion's Seals to buy it.

Wyrmrest Guardians are red dragon guards for Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.
Wyrmskull Tablets can be found all over the ground in Utgarde Catacombs in the Howling Fjord.
Wub's Electrospike Spaulders are a world drop from Northrend mobs.
The Wyrmclaw Battleaxe can be looted from the Cache of Eregos after defeating Ley-Guardian Eregos in the Oculus on normal mode.
Wyrmfire Gloves are a quest reward from Through Fields of Flame.
The Writhing Mass is created by combining 10 Tainted Essence.

The Writ of Merit was mailed to max level jewelcrafters at the release of patch 3.2.0. It was an exchange for the change to Dragon's Eye cuts in the patch, with a "reward" of 5 Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Tokens.
Wristguards of Subterranean Moss drops from Ick in Pit of Saron on normal difficulty.
Wyrmkin Firebrands are red dragonspawn found outside of Grim Batol in the Wetlands.
__NOTOC__ Wyrmrest Vanquisher is a red dragon players ride in On Ruby Wings. It is summoned with the Ruby Beacon of the Dragon Queen.
Wyrmkin Dreamwalkers are green dragonspawn found in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Wyrmrest Skytalon is a red drake lent to players by Corastrasza to be used in the quest Aces High! and the subsequent daily by the same name (Aces High! (daily)). They also serve players in the third and final phase of the Malygos encounter.

Wretched Lost Ones are Lost Ones located in northwestern Blasted Lands.
Wyrmbreaker's Rookery is an area within the Bastion of Twilight where Halfus Wyrmbreaker resides.

Wretched Pathstriders are Wretched found at Quel'Lithien Lodge in Eastern Plaguelands.

__NOTOC__ The Wyvern's Tail is a small inn in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Although not shown in-game, the tavern includes a second floor with numerous rooms and beds and large tables on the main floor for eating. Ironhoof brought the injured orc Malgar to the inn to recuperate.
The Wyrmhunter Hooks are provided as an objective for Blackout (Twilight Highlands).
Wyrmhunter Spaulders is a quest reward from Blackout (quest).

__NOTOC__ Wulfred Harrys is a worgen quest giver located at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn. He has been allowed into the Explorers' League, despite being a worgen. Brother Nimetz sent him the Whispering Blue Stone that the adventurer found in Kurzen's Compound, and Wulfred suspects it might be related to similar-looking rocks that he has seen at the nearby Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound. Samples are then sent to Bronwyn Hewstrike in the Cape of Stranglethorn for further testing. During the events of Rise of the Zandalari, he was poisoned but soon healed by Bwemba.
Wyrmrest Captains are tauren defending Wyrmrest Temple during the Dragon Soul raid. They command Wyrmrest Defenders. It is unclear if they are transformed dragons or mortals in service of dragons.

Wyll Benton was an elderly servant of Anduin Wrynn. He had been taking care of Anduin since the king was little and refusing his service would offend him. As far as the king of Stormwind knew, Wyll had no family and was in service to the Wrynn family almost his entire life, having served King Llane and King Varian when they, too, were young. Though old and gray-haired, Wyll was tall and heavyset. Even though he was sarcastic, Anduin knew he was a kind man, and his mild, slightly detached demeanor disguised a stubborn will and fierce devotion to the house of Wrynn. Wu-Song Villagers are pandaren found at Wu-Song Village on the Wandering Isle. They are under attack of Fe-Feng Hozens.
Wuk-Wuk is the second enemy to accost on his first visit to the (uninstanced) Stormstout Brewery. Chen retells the story in Broken Dreams.
Wyneth is a centaur found near the Stagnant Oasis in the Barrens, who needs to be killed in Verog the Dervish (quest) to lure out her mate Verog.

Wu-Peng is a pandaren located in Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit. He was traveling with his father's caravan when they were attacked by the Inkgill jinyu. In the fighting, he ran and hid. His father later sent adventurers of the Alliance and Horde to find him, afterwhich the son and father were reunited.
Wu Kao Disciples are pandaren loacted at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

The Writhingwood can be found in east-central Dread Wastes, bordered clockwise from the north by the Forgotten Mire, the Serpent's Spine, the southern fork of the Horrid March to Stoneplow in Valley of the Four Winds, and Klaxxi'vess.
Six Wu Kao Darts of Lethargy can be found in the Bag of Wu Kao Supplies at the feet of Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison along with 10xShiny Shado-Pan Coin.
The Wu Kao Explosive was provided as an objective by Kun Autumnlight for the Golden Lotus daily quest Cannonfire.
Wu Kao Scouting Reports could be found, typically on tables, all over Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Shao-Tien Pillagers had picked some up as well.
Wulon is a quilen located in the Silent Sanctuary in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Wytemajic is the Guild Master of "The Crimson Guard" on Azuremyst, which was renamed to "Blizzard Mentor Horde" when the guild joined the Guild Mentoring Program on August 30, 2012. Wytemajic became an MVP on September 6, 2012.
Wu Kao Lee is a pandaren that appears inside Shado-Pan Fallback in Kun-Lai Summit.
Wu-Lai, Bladed Fan of the Empyreans drops from Twin Consorts in Throne of Thunder.
The Wrought Formal Dagger is a quest reward from Time For Change.
